meta.name: Fund the new buybackv2-deployer wallet with gas ETH only (TEMPLATE)

transactions._comment: Sends 0.001 ETH (plain transfer) to a BRAND NEW keystore you create yourself (suggested name: 'buybackv2-deployer') -- never the old compromised deployer 0xA2774e53dCb666799dbA7d00dC11d10d7Ff837D1. A prior dry run of this exact script (2026-09-30) estimated the deploy cost at ~0.0000690 ETH, so 0.001 ETH is ~14x margin, still negligible on this L2 -- re-run the dry run yourself before funding to confirm that estimate still holds (see docs/BUYBACK_BURN_GO_LIVE.md step 2). This wallet is gas-only: it deploys BuybackBurnerV2 (one transaction, nonce 0, no owner -- see contracts/src/BuybackBurnerV2.sol) and does nothing else ever again.
